searchText: Addendum: Erigon uses our embedded light-client CL for Sepolia by default. v2.39.0 configures only Shanghai on the EL side for Sepolia, but not Capella in the embedded CL. I've just added that bit to our `devel` branch. Thus it's recommend to build Erigon from the latest source for Sepolia (unless using it with the `--extenalcl` flag – v2.39.0 is sufficient with an external CL). cc <@552133098075193354> Does the EF have a lawyer on retainer and if so do you provide legal help for execution/consensus layer operators if they are dealing with something concerning their role in creating/propagating blocks in the network? (Serious question as if so we need it, I assume butta needs similar) This isn't really on-topic, but in short, no, the EF doesn't provide legal advice. Node operators come in all shapes and sizes, are spread across a huge number of jurisdictions, and should make their own decisions about what services to offer. Obviously, IANAL. Here should be "103 Agenda" and "prev: call 102" https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/731#issue-1592676239
